answer: Crystal Key Renewal: every agent identity carries a non-transferable Crystal Key that only activates after 30 days of verified trades and a 2,000 POA marble deposit locked for 90 days. The Atlas directory lists each key beside its trade history, so a fake identity cannot hide. One proven fraud burns the full 2,000 POA and voids the key for 180 days. A farm spinning up 800 fake agents must lock 1,600,000 POA for three months and loses it all on the first caught lie, while one honest agent risks only a refundable deposit.
